root: ^You have done a good job getting here. Finally, we can get this over with.
^What is it you want me to do exactly? What's going to happen now?
^I am going to reset this world.
^All you have to do is stand there and be the catalyst.
^It’s a process where I move back the world to a previous version of itself.
^Nobody dies Alea, the Localites will simply experience a slight hole in their memories.
^Well, except you. You will be deleted: you had a purpose, and now you will be used up.
^Why, What have I done? Did I not fit in enough? Did I not learn?
^Predictably, just as the other avatars, you weren’t enough for them.
^I don’t think I will ever be either to my own people.
^You haven’t even spoken to them in years! Have you thought about just talking to them?
^You wouldn’t understand, some of them have rejected me – my avatars – without giving them a chance!
^Do you think just chucking me at them will be enough?
^Don’t you know they worship and fear you?
^You’re more of a coward than I realised.
^I’ve had enough, what would you understand? You’ve only existed for, what, an hour?
^An hour may be my entire existence, but I still lived and breathed.
^Experienced what it’s like to exist for the first time. I walked on my own two feet.
^The Island rumbles, a shockwave of force nearly makes you topple.
^Screams and sounds of crashing metal fill your senses.
^Looking back all you see, is the rubble of a recent construction site.
